verdict.rationale: The pricing docs describe a configurable `timeout` option set at sandbox creation, with a 5-minute default and `sandbox.extendTimeout()` to lengthen it. Manual stop is also available from the dashboard. Because this appears on the pricing page, timeouts are framed as a cost-control mechanism. missing for 10: evidence of idle-based (inactivity) auto-shutdown as opposed to a fixed wall-clock timeout, explicit statement that billing stops on timeout/stop, independent or hands-on corroboration.
